## What

`skills/aaif-audit-slack/scripts/audit_spam.py` is a read-only, on-demand audit that ranks members by sales-pitch signals. It looks for:
- services and partnership pitches
- "DM me"
- LinkedIn-account rental offers
- money bait
- one message pasted into 3 or more channels
- pitches outside the promo channels

It scans every public channel **and its threads** over a window, plus `search.messages`, which reaches only the token owner's own DMs. That is the one place the LinkedIn-rental offers show up.

- Output goes to the terminal only. **No message text is written to disk.**
- Snippets print inside `<<msg>>` markers, because message text is untrusted input.
- Shared vendor rooms (`ext-*`) and `*-organizers` rooms are not scored.
- Results are leads, not verdicts. Deactivation stays a human call in the admin panel.
- It is not part of `aaif-sync`.

## Allowlist change

`conversations.replies` and `search.messages` are added to `aaif_events.slack.ALLOWED_METHODS`, with this script as their caller. Both are reads, and the reason is recorded next to the list.

## Live finding: `oldest=` is unreliable

Verified live on 2026-10-15: `conversations.history` called with `oldest=` sometimes returned `ok` with **zero messages** for channels that had traffic inside the window. The same call without `oldest` was reliable. One run therefore saw 58 posters where the correct figure was 544. The script now pages without `oldest` and stops at the window edge itself, and the summary line prints how many channels came back empty, so a repeat of this shows up.

`audit_activity` / `history_activity()` still pass `oldest=` and may under-count the same way. That is not changed here.

## Review fixes (second commit)

`/code-review` found 10 issues, all fixed here, each with a test:
- **Scopes and search:** scopes are checked up front, and a search failure no longer throws away a finished scan.
- **Cross-post attribution:** a cross-post is credited only to the person who pasted every copy. Working rooms, promo channels and DMs are excluded.
- **LinkedIn pattern:** `linkedin-rent` no longer matches "share your LinkedIn".
- **Old threads:** threads under a parent older than the window are read when their replies fall inside it (`--thread-lookback`, default 365 days).
- **Markers:** `<<`/`>>` inside message text and display names are neutralised.
- **App posts:** messages with a `bot_id` are excluded, as in `history_activity`.
- **Incomplete runs:** skipped channels and capped search queries print as INCOMPLETE instead of reading as quiet.
- **Shared code:** uses the shared `Slack.paged`, and DM hits are keyed by channel id.

## Test plan
- [x] `python skills/aaif-audit-slack/scripts/test_audit_spam.py` (synthetic data only)
- [x] pre-commit hooks on the changed files, including the PII, portability and banner checks
- [x] Live smoke run after the fixes, 7 days: 310 channels, 50 threads, 12 search hits, 0 skipped
- [x] Live run, 90 days (before the fixes): 310 channels, 431 threads, 544 posters, 23 flagged; one channel skipped on a DNS error
